note: Files whose code line count (comments, blank lines and docstrings excluded -- see scripts/code_line_count.py) is over 800. A file listed here may not go over the "limit" number next to it. Any file not listed here may not go over 800. `python scripts/growth_limit.py --record` keeps this file in sync with reality, but it never raises a limit by itself -- a file that has grown past its own recorded limit is left alone and reported as refused. To grow a listed file's limit on purpose: review the growth, then run `python scripts/growth_limit.py --raise <path> --reason "<why>"`, which writes the new number, the reason, and today's date. Written by scripts/growth_limit.py -- do not hand-edit.
